title: BotInputVariable
description: Typed input variable value to pass to a bot at deployment time

type.description: Data type of the variable. Must match the variable type defined in the bot (e.g., STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, LIST, DICTIONARY, DATETIME).

string.description: String value for STRING type variables

number.description: Numeric value as a string for NUMBER type variables

boolean.description: Boolean value for BOOLEAN type variables

list.description: List structure for LIST type variables

dictionary.description: Key-value map for DICTIONARY type variables
